_readme: NPC definitions and dialogue. Each talk returns ONE random line from the NPC's pool, so every line you add is new content players can encounter. Tone rules live in docs/proposal.md §4: grounded, no magic, no modern slang. See docs/lore/README.md for the contribution guide.

npcs.name: Silas Crane
lines: New face. Keep your voice down and your coin close — this cove has ears.
You didn't hear it from me, but the Spaniards lost a strongbox off the north reef. Salvage crews start at dawn. Anyone diving tonight keeps what they find.
The Crown's offering pardons come autumn, they say. Half this cove will take one. The other half will hang the half that did.
See that wreck past the dock? Carried silver, the story goes. Carried fever too. Mind which one you bring back.
A captain in a black coat was asking after new faces last night. Asking nice. Too nice.
Storm season's coming. The smart ones are caching powder somewhere dry. The smarter ones already know where everyone else's cache is.
